Fresno State ranks 78th on offense, converting on 39% of third downs. Fresno State is 11th in the FBS with a +8 turnover margin. Both teams avoid getting penalized. Fresno State leads the FBS averaging 30.1 penalty yards per game, and Colorado State ranks 18th with a 42.4-yard average. Fresno State is 15th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 74.2% of red zone trips. Colorado State is 127th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:34. Team leaders Fresno State Passing: Jayden Mandal, 2,107 yards, 12 TDs, 3 INTs, 61.8 completion percentage Rushing: Bryson Donelson, 446 yards on 97 carries, 8 TDs Receiving: Josiah Freeman, 695 yards on 51 catches, 4 TDs Colorado State Passing: Hauss Hejny, 1,590 yards, 16 TDs, 3 INTs, 64.5 completion percentage Rushing: Durell Robinson, 474 yards on 113 carries, 9 TDs Receiving: Reginald Vick Jr., 510 yards on 34 catches, 4 TDs Last game Fresno State fell to Texas State 37-35 on Nov. 14. Mandal passed for 250 yards on 20-of-34 attempts (58.8%) with one touchdown and one interception. Donelson carried the ball 10 times for 24 yards and scored two touchdowns, adding two receptions for 10 yards. Freeman had six receptions for 69 yards. Colorado State lost 73-7 to Washington State on Nov. 14. Hejny led Colorado State with 199 yards on 14-of-24 passing (58.3%) for no touchdowns and one interception.
